mapper.select: select d.id as delivery_id, d.device_token_id, t.push_provider, t.token as recipient, t.recipient_type, n.id as notification_id, n.type, n.message as body, n.actor_user_id, n.content_id, n.comment_id, d.attempt_count from notification_deliveries d join notifications n on n.id = d.notification_id join user_device_tokens t on t.id = d.device_token_id where ( (d.status in ('pending', 'retry') and d.next_attempt_at <= #{now}) or (d.status = 'processing' and d.claimed_at <= #{claimDeadline}) ) and d.attempt_count < #{maxAttempts} and n.created_at > #{expiryCutoff} and t.enabled = true order by d.next_attempt_at, d.created_at, d.id limit #{batchSize} for update skip locked
mapper.update: update notification_deliveries set status = 'processing', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, claimed_at = #{claimedAt}, claimed_by = #{claimOwner}, last_error = null where id = #{deliveryId} and ( status in ('pending', 'retry') or (status = 'processing' and claimed_at <= #{claimDeadline}) )

update notification_deliveries set status = 'dead', claimed_at = null, claimed_by = null, last_error = #{lastError} where status in ('pending', 'retry') and exists ( select 1 from user_device_tokens where user_device_tokens.id = notification_deliveries.device_token_id and user_device_tokens.enabled = false )

update notification_deliveries set status = 'dead', claimed_at = null, claimed_by = null, last_error = #{lastError} where status in ('pending', 'retry') and exists ( select 1 from notifications where notifications.id = notification_deliveries.notification_id and notifications.created_at <= #{expiryCutoff} )
update notification_deliveries set status = 'dead', claimed_at = null, claimed_by = null, last_error = #{lastError} where status in ('pending', 'retry') and attempt_count >= #{maxAttempts}

update notification_deliveries set status = 'delivered', delivered_at = #{deliveredAt}, provider_message_id = #{providerMessageId}, claimed_at = null, claimed_by = null, last_error = null where id = #{deliveryId} and status = 'processing' and claimed_by = #{claimOwner}
